unit_attributes.statement: When an ATC clearance has been obtained, no pilot in command may deviate from that clearance unless an amended clearance is obtained, an emergency exists, or the deviation is in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When an ATC clearance has been obtained, unless an amended clearance is obtained, an emergency exists, or the deviation is in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory

unit_attributes.statement: Except in Class A airspace, a pilot may cancel an IFR flight plan if the operation is being conducted in VFR weather conditions.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except in Class A airspace, if the operation is being conducted in VFR weather conditions

unit_attributes.statement: When a pilot is uncertain of an ATC clearance, that pilot shall immediately request clarification from ATC.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When a pilot is uncertain of an ATC clearance

unit_attributes.statement: Except in an emergency, no person may operate an aircraft contrary to an ATC instruction in an area in which air traffic control is exercised.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In an area in which air traffic control is exercised, except in an emergency

unit_attributes.statement: Each pilot in command who, in an emergency, or in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory, deviates from an ATC clearance or instruction shall notify ATC of that deviation as soon as possible.
unit_attributes.actor: Each pilot in command who, in an emergency, or in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory, deviates from an ATC clearance or instruction
unit_attributes.actor_quote: Each pilot in command who, in an emergency, or in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory, deviates from an ATC clearance or instruction
unit_attributes.scope_text: When a pilot in command, in an emergency, or in response to a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory, deviates from an ATC clearance or instruction

unit_attributes.statement: Each pilot in command who (though not deviating from a rule of this subpart) is given priority by ATC in an emergency, shall submit a detailed report of that emergency within 48 hours to the manager of that ATC facility, if requested by ATC.
unit_attributes.actor: Each pilot in command who (though not deviating from a rule of this subpart) is given priority by ATC in an emergency
unit_attributes.actor_quote: Each pilot in command who (though not deviating from a rule of this subpart) is given priority by ATC in an emergency
unit_attributes.scope_text: If given priority by ATC in an emergency (though not deviating from a rule of this subpart), and if requested by ATC

unit_attributes.statement: Unless otherwise authorized by ATC, no person operating an aircraft may operate that aircraft according to any clearance or instruction that has been issued to the pilot of another aircraft for radar air traffic control purposes.
unit_attributes.modality_quote: no person operating an aircraft may

ATC light signals have the meaning shown in the specified table.
With respect to aircraft on the surface, a steady green ATC light signal means cleared for takeoff.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, a steady green ATC light signal means cleared to land.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft on the surface, a flashing green ATC light signal means cleared to taxi.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, a flashing green ATC light signal means return for landing (to be followed by steady green at proper time).
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft on the surface, a steady red ATC light signal means stop.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, a steady red ATC light signal means give way to other aircraft and continue circling.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft on the surface, a flashing red ATC light signal means taxi clear of runway in use.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, a flashing red ATC light signal means airport unsafe—do not land.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft on the surface, a flashing white ATC light signal means return to starting point on airport.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, a flashing white ATC light signal is not applicable.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft on the surface, an alternating red and green ATC light signal means exercise extreme caution.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft on the surface

unit_attributes.statement: With respect to aircraft in flight, an alternating red and green ATC light signal means exercise extreme caution.
unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to aircraft in flight
